name: HMMT-25
intro: HMMT-25 是 MathArena 收录的 2025 年 2 月 Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament 题集，由代数、几何、组合三场个人赛各 10 道题组成，不含邀请赛/HMIC；该赛事单独举行。30 道题经提取、格式统一和人工核验；MathArena 以四次独立作答的 pass@1 准确率评估模型，并结合符号等价解析、语义判题和人工复核降低评分误差。
build_method: 官方赛题提取、格式标准化、人工核验
metric: Pass@1 Accuracy（4 次独立运行均值）, Score/Rank Confidence Intervals
eval_feature: 新近竞赛、发布日期标记、四次独立运行、解析器与语义判题复核
scale: 30 道 HMMT 2025 年 2 月个人赛题（3 场 × 每场 10 道）
build_method_en: Official problem extraction, format standardization, human verification
eval_feature_en: Fresh competition, release-date flags, four independent runs, parser and semantic-judge review
intro_en: HMMT-25 is the February 2025 Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament set included in MathArena. Its Algebra, Geometry, and Combinatorics individual tests contain 10 problems each. The benchmark explicitly excludes Invitational/HMIC, which is a separate competition. The 30 problems are extracted from official materials, standardized, and manually verified. MathArena evaluates four independent responses with pass@1 accuracy and combines symbolic-equivalence parsing, semantic judging, and manual review to reduce scoring errors.
scale_en: 30 HMMT February 2025 problems (three individual tests of 10)
metric_en: Pass@1 Accuracy (mean of 4 independent runs), Score/Rank Confidence Intervals

drawio_review_note: Aligned with MathArena arXiv:2505.23281v3, the paper-era official code commit 462e6f4, and released dataset revision 6fdc427. HMMT February 2025 has three individual tests of 10 problems each, covering Algebra, Geometry, and Combinatorics; this benchmark excludes the separate Invitational/HMIC. The pinned dataset has 30 rows with problem_idx, problem, answer, and problem_type under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Official competition problems are standardized and manually checked for typographical errors, inconsistencies, and formatting. Each model produces four independent responses per problem with provider-recommended settings and no benchmark-specific tuning. The HMMT prompt requires step-by-step reasoning and a boxed final answer. A custom rule parser converts LaTeX into SymPy structures; a Gemini-2.5-Flash semantic-equivalence audit and GUI flags for truncation, parser errors, or gold answers left in the reasoning trace feed manual reconciliation and parser regression tests. The primary score is pass@1 averaged over four runs with no majority vote, plus 95% score/rank confidence intervals and release-date contamination flags. The pinned HMMT config records T=0.6, max 16,000 tokens, and strict_parsing=false; dataset revision 6fdc427 is later than code pin 462e6f4.
